commands.name: StartTicketSourceImportCheck
commands.transaction_boundary: one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork only for idempotency, durable job enqueue/coalescing, audit and result; discovery/parsing occur after commit
guards: automatic requires the correct configured inbox; Advanced Search never silently reuses RFC/WFM inbox
manual selected_path is validated as untrusted local path before job creation and cannot bypass later stability/XLSX/profile validation
commands.idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; hash includes source family, invocation kind and canonical semantic source locator
commands.receipt_order: revalidate/coalescing decision -> insert command receipt -> enqueue/coalesce durable job -> append ticket_import.check_started.v1 + result -> commit
mutations: LLD-01 command receipt/job/audit/result only; no LLD-04 source row or domain mutation yet

commands.name: PublishStagedImportRun
commands.request_type: complete parser result + exact run/profile/checkpoint inputs defined by ticket_import.source_check job contract
commands.transaction_boundary: bounded staging batches may commit while run remains unpublished validating; final publication/replay classification is one short UoW
authoritative_reads: complete unpublished observations/fields/findings and exact recomputed counts/fingerprint
guards: candidate remains exact stable source opened by job
all profile/header/vocabulary/parser versions equal run provenance
validating rows remain non-authoritative until publication
commands.idempotency: job checkpoint + expected run revision; repeated publication of same committed state is NO_CHANGE
commands.receipt_order: internal job transition uses caller job operation identity; revalidate -> insert/confirm technical receipt where required by LLD-01 job contract -> guarded cleanup/publication writes -> audit/result -> commit
commands.revision_effects: successful publication/noop state increments import_runs revision exactly once; failed/no-change does not
commands.audit_action: ticket_import.run_published.v1 when source evidence is published; replay/noop uses bounded source-check result without domain audit duplication
commands.post_commit_work: none except job continuation to review/noop checkpoint as dictated by committed state

commands.name: AcceptReconciliationProposal
commands.transaction_boundary: one short outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork shared with exactly one owning-domain mutation service and all required participants
authoritative_reads: owning-domain source_acceptance_base_token/current reference or plan/lifecycle state
guards: recovery_required parent has latest exact-fingerprint authorized review
owning-domain base token still equals proposal base token
proposal_kind resolves to one static owner service
commands.idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; hash binds proposal id/revision/fingerprint/base token/reason where material
commands.receipt_order: authoritative revalidation/no-change -> insert one outer receipt -> owning-domain participant writes -> LLD-04 disposition/proposal/counter writes -> owner + LLD-04 audits/results -> commit
mutations: exact LLD-03 or LLD-05 owner writes; LLD-02/06 only through required same-UoW participants
commands.revision_effects: proposal revision increments once on accepted transition; run revision increments with counter change; owner revisions follow owner contract; NO_CHANGE increments none
commands.post_commit_work: refresh review projections only; terminal RFC cascade and Objective regrouping remain separate explicit workflows

commands.name: RejectReconciliationProposal
guards: recovery review current when parent recovery_required
commands.receipt_order: revalidate/no-change -> insert receipt -> disposition/equivalence/proposal/counter writes -> audit/result -> commit
commands.revision_effects: proposal/run revision increment exactly once; domain revisions unchanged

commands.name: DeferReconciliationProposal
guards: recovery review current when parent recovery_required
commands.receipt_order: revalidate/no-change -> insert receipt -> disposition/equivalence/proposal/counter writes -> audit/result -> commit
commands.revision_effects: proposal/run revision increment exactly once; domain revisions unchanged

commands.name: FinalizeImportRunReview
commands.transaction_boundary: one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork containing final run state, checkpoint/recovery event, audit and result
authoritative_reads: latest exact recovery authorization when applicable
guards: run is staged|waiting_review or authorized recovery_required
commands.receipt_order: revalidate/no-change -> insert receipt -> checkpoint/recovery-event/run writes -> ticket_import.run_finalized.v1 + result -> commit
commands.revision_effects: run revision increments once; checkpoint revision increments only when changed; older recovery never decrements/replaces higher chronology

commands.name: RecordNewerIdenticalSourceCheck
commands.request_type: noop_pending_checkpoint import_run_id + expected run/checkpoint revisions + operation identity
commands.idempotency: exact job operation identity and expected revisions
commands.receipt_order: revalidate/no-change -> receipt -> checkpoint/run writes -> ticket_import.checkpoint_advanced.v1 + result -> commit
commands.revision_effects: checkpoint/run revision increment once; domain revisions unchanged

commands.name: ResolveImportRecovery
commands.receipt_order: revalidate/no-change -> insert receipt -> append recovery review; reject additionally supersedes pending proposals/dispositions and terminates run -> audit/result -> commit
commands.revision_effects: review ordinal advances once; reject increments affected proposal/run revisions; authorize/defer leave domain state unchanged
commands.post_commit_work: none; authorization only opens normal per-proposal review path

worker_recovery: unpublished validating rows never participate in source/review/domain authority
resume requires exact source/profile/checkpoint compatibility; otherwise fail unpublished attempt and start fresh
published evidence is never cleaned as technical staging
